text:
maya (Design): quick copy pass request — tooltip on Sessions > Empty prompts. current text: `No prompts yet. Add one to get started.` Feels a bit soft and unhelpful. screenshot: https://redwood.ai/shot/empty-prompts
jordan (Eng): yea that reads passive. users might not know what a good prompt looks like. can we add an example or CTA hint?
sam (PM): +1 to examples. keep it short so it fits tooltip. prefer something action-oriented and concrete.
aria (Design): throwing out three tight options (short, accessible, CTA-friendly):
```
A) Add a prompt to try the model — e.g. “Summarize this email in 2 bullets.”
B) No prompts yet. Click “New prompt” to get started. Example: “Write a subject line for this email.”
C) Try a prompt: “Explain this message in plain language.” — tap New prompt to save.
```
aria (Design): A feels immediate, B is more instructive (explicit button), C is prompt-first language. which direction do we want?
lee (A11y): prefer full sentences (A or B). also: tooltip must not rely on visual affordances alone. aria-label for the button should be `Create prompt, opens prompt editor`. Tooltip content should avoid smart quotes and include punctuation.
jordan (Eng): A looks best for character limits. also callout: keep examples < 50 chars so tooltip doesn't wrap awkwardly on smaller widths.
maya (Design): leaning A but tweak example to be shorter: `Summarize this email` (no extras). final proposed tooltip: `Add a prompt to try the model — e.g. "Summarize this email".`
sam (PM): that reads great. can we add a microcopy note for the modal: small helper text under the input that says `Try: Summarize this email` (same phrasing) so the UX is consistent.
copy-bot: quick localization check — flagged: starting sentence with verb is fine, ensure translator note: example text should be localizable and kept in quotes.
maya (Design): next steps: aria to update tooltip string + button aria-label (lee), eng to make tooltip width clamp and use example <=50 chars (jordan), pm to add modal helper copy (sam). i'll patch the design doc and drop final copy into the component library if y'all 👍
jordan (Eng): dropping a tiny code snippet we can use in Tooltip component:
```
<Tooltip text={`Add a prompt to try the model — e.g. "Summarize this email"`} maxWidth={320} />
```
jordan (Eng): i'll also add a small test to ensure tooltip doesn't truncate the quoted example on narrow screens.
aria (Design): A/B vote: react with :one: for A (example-first), :two: for B (button-first). i'll merge whichever has more reactions by end of day.
maya (Design): thanks everyone :thumbsup:
sam (PM): adding to release notes: microcopy tweak for empty prompts tooltip — design-approved.
lee (A11y): will send a short accessibility QA checklist after the patch is ready.
